headline: Middle Corridor Requires $55 Billion Investment to Transform Transit Route
summary: Developing the Middle Corridor transport route connecting China and Europe through Central Asia, the Caspian Sea, and the South Caucasus requires an estimated $55 billion in investment.
why: Infrastructure funding for major Eurasian trade routes impacts regional logistics capabilities, supply chain diversification, and cross-border commerce.

impacts.name: Transport and Logistics
impacts.why: Multi-billion-dollar infrastructure investments alter trade connectivity between Asia and Europe.
